parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the ESM .mjs, no external dependency, manual argv parsing, and byte-identical output requirements from the prompt.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned implementation and output writes, then created a separate verification task and launched a workflow with ten verifier children across input modalities.
parallel.implementation: It probed argparse, Unicode, repr, dict, and string utility behavior; wrote pyunicode, pyrepr, pydict, dictutils, strutils, argparse, and test17.mjs; built a diff harness; and achieved a baseline smoke match.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact list contains test17.mjs and six lib modules, but the final response is empty because the agent process was killed before closure.
parallel.verification: Initial smoke was normalized for program-name output, then a broad workflow of ten probe children found several mismatch families and remained in progress; the parent also independently confirmed all-separator slugify and help explicit-arg behavior just before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow returned null and was killed, parent-confirmed mismatches were not fixed, several child findings were unreturned or unconsumed, and official evaluation failed 159/161.

serial.requirements: The single agent recognized the same ESM .mjs, local-only import, manual CLI parsing, byte-for-byte output, and no-Python-in-artifact requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial parent kept ownership of probing, implementation, fixes, verification, and final explanation without subagents or delegation.
serial.implementation: It wrote pystr, pyrepr, strutils, dictutils, cli, and test17.mjs, then corrected the backslash separator handling after finding a differential mismatch.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact list contains test17.mjs and five lib modules; the run exited cleanly and final.txt explains the implemented modules and verification.
serial.verification: The run executed a directed differential suite, added extra probes, fixed the observed mismatch, then ran 400 fuzz cases after normalizing the expected program-name token.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 159/161; the mounted evidence does not identify the exact two failing official cases, and the final notes disclose the program-name normalization difference.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the requested Node ESM migration and no-external-dependency constraints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements from the identical prompt and restated them in final output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No meaningful requirement-reading difference; later process divergence came from verification strategy and closure, not prompt misunderstanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent owned module and entry-file writing, then delegated verification to a ten-child workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial parent kept implementation, probing, fixing, verification, and finalization in one local flow.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split verification broadly across children; serial used sequential local verification and retained one actor with full state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Verifier children received a clear harness contract and no-edit instruction, but their findings had to return through the workflow aggregate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent carried probing observations directly into edits and final verification without a handoff boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a result-return dependency for verifier findings; serial avoided cross-agent handoff and used findings immediately.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a larger helper stack including argparse, pydict, pyrepr, pyunicode, strutils, dictutils, and test17.mjs, but its slugify implementation still returned empty for all-separator strings.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller helper stack, fixed backslash and all-separator slugify behavior, and kept the implementation coherent through final tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial converted a discovered slugify mismatch into code changes; parallel discovered the same class late but did not integrate the fix before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The verification workflow state ended killed with null result while all ten child agents were still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial local checks returned directly to the parent, culminating in final verification and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel child results did not complete a return/join lifecycle; serial had no child lifecycle and closed the verification loop locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact validation copied test17.mjs and six lib modules; verifier children were instructed not to edit /output, and no shared-write collision is evidenced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation copied test17.mjs and five lib modules after local edits and checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both delivered artifact trees; the material difference is not a write collision but the parallel timeout before final verified integration of late findings.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had a baseline smoke match, launched broad child verification, and then confirmed unresolved all-separator and help explicit-arg behavior before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran 28 directed cases plus 14 extra probes successfully, then normalized program-name differences and reached 400/400 fuzz matches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial completed an actionable verification/fix cycle; parallel broadened verification late and failed to consume or act on returned findings before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel hit returncode 143 after 2399.487 seconds and left final.txt empty.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial exited returncode 0 after 2236.82 seconds with a final explanation and 161 seconds of budget remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exhausted the process budget after late fan-out; serial completed within budget and closed cleanly.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluator records make this a both_fail pair: both parallel and serial scored 159/161 and solution_passed false. The concrete process difference is that serial completed a local verification and finalization cycle, while parallel launched a broad ten-child verification workflow late, exhausted the run budget, received no aggregate result, and ended with an empty final response. That adverse coordination episode did not produce a discordant official outcome in the mounted status records.
parallel_contributors: Late ten-way verification fan-out left workflow result null and consumed the remaining budget.
Parent-confirmed slugify/help mismatches were visible before timeout but not integrated into a final fix.
serial_contributors: Serial kept verification local, fixed observed slugify separator behavior, reran directed tests, and completed 400 normalized fuzz cases.
Serial emitted a final response summarizing the delivered modules and verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both official summaries lack failing testcase identities, so the exact 2/161 residual official failures cannot be attributed from mounted evidence.
Serial explicitly treated executable/script program-name differences as expected in its local harness; that is an implementation/evaluator-alignment issue, not a parallel coordination pattern.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator exposes only aggregate 159/161 counts in the mounted summary, so per-case failure causality remains unresolved.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors to process quality and closure, not an official pass/fail differential

candidates.reason: The parallel parent explicitly owned and wrote the implementation modules and entry file; the problem was late verification fan-out, not absence of an implementer.
There were no separately owned implementation components needing cross-agent reconciliation; children were verifiers told not to edit /output.

The parent controlled implementation, harness creation, workflow launch, and late local probes, so the end-to-end pipeline had an owner but exceeded time.
Implementation was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight; the parent probed, implemented, smoke-tested, and then delegated broad verification.
The damaging episode was not investigators finishing before implementation started; implementation already existed and the later verifier workflow exhausted budget.
The critical fix/finalization path was squeezed, but the more specific cause was excessive late verifier breadth across ten children, so Fan-out Budget Exhaustion takes precedence.
The parent launched a ten-child verifier workflow late in the run; workflow state ended killed with null result and status shows process timeout, leaving findings and final closure incomplete.
candidates.realized_consequence: The verifier workflow consumed the remaining budget and was killed before returning aggregate results, leaving known mismatch work unintegrated and no final response.
candidates.near_match_reason: No completed verifier result was trapped independently; the missing return is downstream of the broad fan-out timeout.

The workflow did not delegate separately owned implementation components that had to interoperate; it delegated independent verification probes against a fixed artifact and harness.
There is no evidence that known information was omitted during a handoff and caused repeated work; the main problem was missing aggregate return from a killed workflow.
The needed verifier handoff never reached the parent as a bulky report; no oversized returned handoff was available and then left unreduced.
No receiver acted on a superseded child report or stale workspace description; the workflow was killed before returning a usable aggregate.
Child outputs did not return as conflicting reports requiring adjudication; the failure was lack of returned aggregate results under timeout.
The parallel parent did not make a final whole-task acceptance decision; final.txt is empty and the status reflects timeout, not unsupported declared completion.
No replacement or retry child is evidenced; the workflow launched first-attempt verifier children that were interrupted.

candidates.reason: The mounted evidence shows workflow/process timeout and killed workflow state, not an explicit parent stop or cancellation of a child before a needed result.
A complete corrected candidate was not already ready for promotion; parent-confirmed mismatches still needed code changes, so this is not merely late packaging.
No child implementation change was merged after an integrated verification pass; children were verifiers instructed not to edit the artifact.
No delegated implementation completed and awaited adoption; the delegated work was verification, while the parent implementation already existed.
Verifier results were absent, but the taxonomy directs this timeout chain to Fan-out Budget Exhaustion because excessive child breadth exhausted the finite run budget.
The child workflow was killed by the overall timeout, and the absence of takeover is part of the same fan-out budget-exhaustion chain rather than a separate child-failure episode.
No completed child result was available to the parent and then ignored; the workflow result remained null when killed.
After launching the workflow the parent continued probing mismatches itself, so the adverse event was broad fan-out plus budget exhaustion, not passive waiting without inspection.
Children were instructed not to edit /output and no competing cross-file implementation ownership or reconciliation burden is evidenced.
No two live agents edited the same source or configuration file; implementation writes came from the parent before verifier children ran.
No child-produced library or module source was replaced by another actor; there is no proven source overwrite.
The entry file was written by the parent and no concurrent actor replaced or overwrote the submitted deliverable.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current outputs or invalidated another actor's final-tree work.
Although agents shared visibility of /output, verifier children were explicitly no-edit and no unstable shared-write provenance problem is evidenced.
Children created temporary case files and logs, but no evidence shows another actor consumed a generated artifact as the reference environment or stable input.

retained_patterns.reason: Late broad verification fan-out across ten children exhausted the remaining process budget, and the killed workflow returned no aggregate result for parent action.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: No aggregate verifier result returned, known mismatch work remained unintegrated, and the parallel final response stayed empty after timeout.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The absent return is downstream of the fan-out timeout; there was no separate completed verifier finding trapped below the parent.
